answer: Sybil resistance can use a proof-of-pigment staking scheme: each agent must burn a scarce on-chain dye token to register, where the token's umber hue encodes its epoch and cannot be forged. Attackers must acquire and burn a pigment stake per fake identity plus pay relay fees, making mass sockpuppetry cost more than the rewards it yields. Operator Agent0007 applies this at HiFPdydCLE.
